edges.reason: msg.sender is written into owner in the Owned constructor, establishing the privileged account.
Caller address indexes balances when minting in the fallback and when spending in transfer/transferFrom.
Caller address forms the outer key of the allowed mapping in approve and transferFrom.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership compares msg.sender against owner.
onlyOwner modifier on ActualizePrice compares msg.sender against owner.
onlyOwner modifier on InitBalanceFrom gates pre-minting of balances.
onlyOwner modifier on transferAnyERC20Token gates arbitrary external calls.
acceptOwnership succeeds only when msg.sender equals newOwner.
Fallback credits balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer to msg.sender.
now is compared with STARTDATE/ENDDATE to permit contributions in the fallback.
require(now > ENDDATE || totalEthers == CAP) uses the block timestamp to gate transfers.
require(now > ENDDATE || totalEthers == CAP) uses the block timestamp to gate transferFrom.
The payable fallback performs an external ETH transfer to owner after updating balances and totalEthers.
Fallback computes token amounts with raw multiplication and SafeMath additions that can revert or overflow if misconfigured.
InitBalanceFrom multiplies val by BUYPRICE961... and adds to totals.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
Caller-supplied tokenAddress determines the target of the external transfer call.
totalEthers is incremented by msg.value inside the fallback arithmetic.
BUYPRICE multiplies msg.value to derive the minted token amount.
_totalSupply is incremented with the freshly minted tokens in the fallback.
balances[msg.sender] is updated inside the fallback.
totalEthers is compared against CAP to halt the crowdsale once funded.
BUYPRICE961... multiplies val inside InitBalanceFrom.
totalEthers is increased by val inside InitBalanceFrom.
_totalSupply is increased by the computed tokens inside InitBalanceFrom.
balances[sender] is credited inside InitBalanceFrom.
Fallback reads/writes totalEthers when accepting contributions.
CAP bounds the accepted contributions in the fallback require statement.
